authority.scope: Implement the already recorded bounded CAD development route. No vehicle, material product, spine count, landing arrangement, travel limit or review baseline is selected.

representative_reopened_observations.interpretation: Failures concern assumed yoke reference geometry and untrimmed nominal tube members. They neither demonstrate manufactured hardware collisions nor establish acceptable joints. The checker evaluates hash-bound observations and arithmetic; it does not itself rerun FreeCAD.

preserved_baseline.preservation: Do not overwrite, repair in place or remove baseline artifacts, diagnostic omissions or unsuccessful cases.

units_and_frames.analysis_units: kg, m, s, N, N m, kg m^2, rad
units_and_frames.restriction: Do not substitute partial tube CG for the complete neutral vehicle CG or the fixed mission datum.

bounded_matrix.product: geometry_baselines x landing_arrangements x spine_hypotheses x combinations
bounded_matrix.restriction: Record unsuccessful cases. No additional ring elevation, phase, travel reduction or envelope shrinking may be introduced silently to obtain a pass.

construction_rules.angle_conversion: Convert degrees to radians before trigonometry.
construction_rules.brace_length_basis: Untrimmed ideal B-J chord; end fittings, insert overlap and finished cuts remain unresolved.
construction_rules.shared_root_rule: Merge coincident reference roots for bookkeeping; do not infer that shared fittings are manufacturable or independently supported.
fixed_in_all_variants: Outer joint origin and outer-to-inner displacement
Both neutral rotor hubs and rotor diameter
Spine section, XY arrangement, length and 20 mm ring-relative root offset
construction_rules.moving_group_ownership: Landing members and spines belong to the fixed airframe. Rotor slabs and the retained yoke reference belong to the inner gimbal group.

retained_reference_envelopes.yoke_bottom_z: Mean of unchanged upper and lower neutral rotor hub Z
retained_reference_envelopes.yoke_corner_rule: Four neutral corners at X=+/-(rotor_radius+30 mm), Y=0, Z in {yoke_top_z,yoke_bottom_z}; transform through the retained separate-origin gimbal convention.
retained_reference_envelopes.mass_contribution: None: reference envelopes are not hardware.
retained_reference_envelopes.attachment_ring_guide: Attachment locus only until a physical section and supports are explicitly modeled.

comparison_observations.density_provenance: Inherited hypothetical CFRP sensitivities, not supplier-certified laminate properties.
required_reporting: Actual component solid validity, volumes, assumed-density mass, partial CG and full inertia
Native reopen and parameter-edit observations; independent STEP observations without assuming solid order
Both rotor envelopes and moving-yoke envelopes versus fixed members and declared joint envelopes
Pose coordinates and governing distance/intersection witnesses
Rigid nominal ground-clearance construction and its contact assumptions
Tube cut-length changes and whole-stock packing consequences
comparison_observations.evidence_boundary: Sampled nominal geometry is not a continuous bound, loaded-clearance acceptance, structural qualification or flight validation.

integration_completion_gate.rule: Tube/reference candidates may be generated for the bounded comparison. Before an integrated comparison or structural down-selection, add explicit preliminary physical ring/support/joint hypotheses, material assignments and mass ownership in a fresh configuration, then assess their actual solids and clearances. Do not report the tube/reference stage as satisfying this gate.
integration_completion_gate.raised_ring_consequence: The 60 mm rise increases the ring-to-gimbal support span. Its stiffness, interfaces, mass and whole-purchase cost cannot be omitted or assumed unchanged.
remaining_missing_items: Ring/plate, gimbal support load path and spine pedestals
Root and brace-junction fittings, inserts, adhesives and fasteners
Feet, compliant pads and positive retention
Motors, propellers, ESCs, battery, avionics and harness

execution_and_verification.generation_backend: Saved sandbox source through freecad_run, headless=true
execution_and_verification.declare_outputs: Enumerate every generated FCStd, STEP, arrangement drawing, diagnostic, measurement and manifest file explicitly in the execution action.
execution_and_verification.source_preservation: Keep supplied repositories, parent configuration, all generator revisions and baseline outputs unchanged.
execution_and_verification.verification: Retain editable artifact-bound check programs; include every tested artifact Ref in verify_command inputs. Report observed failed screens without changing thresholds or waiving intersections. Process success is not acceptance.
execution_and_verification.budget: Whole non-exempt purchase quantities count against strictly less than AUD 500 excluding tax and shipping. PETG filament alone is exempt from cost, not physical mass or structural assessment. No new price observation is made by this configuration.
